0022600113.text: The Pacers (1-1, 3rd in the Central, 1 game back, 9th in the East) visit the Nets (0-2, 12th in the East) for their third game of the season, with Brooklyn on a two-game losing streak. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), and Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with a hamstring strain and a game-time decision. Brooklyn is missing Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), and Tyler Bilodeau is day-to-day with a shoulder injury and a game-time decision.
